title: [Bug]: E-Documents for Germany - FindEDocumentService always selects last matching service, ignoring which service triggered the export
summary: E-Document exports for Germany now use the service that triggered the export instead of always selecting the last matching service, ensuring correct settings like PDF embedding are applied.
key_points: XRechnung format passes the triggering service to Export XRechnung Document through SetEDocumentService
ZUGFeRD uses a new ZUGFeRD Export Context codeunit to carry the service from format into report extensions
FindEDocumentService and OnAfterFindEDocumentService are deprecated but kept working until CLEAN29 for backward compatibility
Tests verify both the new path and legacy fallback work correctly
Context codeunit is public so partners can use it in customized report extensions
quote: The triggering service is now handed to the export instead
